en: You'd pay your rent on time, I bet.
Come chat with this old girl now and then,
why don't you? I'll stand you a drink or so.
To be forced to wither into decrepitude...
How pitiful humans are...
But if, even so, you still wish to cling
to life, then very well.
I shall grant you that wish.
and live on a while longer.
note: After #2010 'Become my servant,'; a pause follows, then #10409.

en: In that aged body of yours.
I'm not from the liquor shop.
I only wanted to say hello.
Good evening. Pardon me a moment.
note: Madeline answers 'If you know it's rude, don't ask.' (#10342).

en: Have you seen anyone suspicious around here?
...I don't suppose you'd know.
note: The slight that #10345 'Stop me, then insult me?' reacts to.

en: ...Pardon me. Until next time.
Good evening, Madeline.
I'm glad to see you looking so well.
Oh, I'm so sorry.
Are you hurt, granny?
note: 'granny' so #10366 'Who're you calling old? Call me Madeline.' answers it (slice 129 request).

en: I'm truly sorry.
Though you seem to be drunk already...
Good afternoon. Excuse me, is anyone in?
For your sake, I would
do anything at all...
This is a hat shop for fine ladies.
Are you after a gift for your sweetheart?
What sort of hats are in fashion now?
Let me see. Lace-trimmed hats
with wide brims are popular.
You're looking for a gift for a lady,
aren't you...
Do take your time and look around.
Ah, any lady who's given a hat by
a handsome gentleman like you...
how happy she must be!
What sort of beautiful lady could she be,
Have you decided on a present yet?
No...
I don't have anyone in particular in mind,
so I'm in no hurry.
Oh my. And yet you've been coming here
almost every day...
Could it be... you've taken a fancy to me?
I can no longer hold back
these feelings of mine...
I do believe I've fallen
in love with you...
Since I fell for you, even the wind
and the rain all sound like lovely music
to my ears...
Had I been born a dog,
I could love you more honestly than now.
I have a feeling...
and I
note: After the name at line start: '{NAME} and I'.

en: are bound by the red thread of fate...
Relax. I'm sure the knot is a loose one.
The shop is about to close...
...Oh, I understand.
You've gone out of your way
to come and see me!
I'm so glad you came to see me.
Hee hee.
Coming here at such an hour...
Is it to ask me out on a date?
I see.
Despite your looks, you're quite the shy
type, aren't you.
Any time you'd like to make a date,
...Yes, that's right.
Would you care for this lace-trimmed hat,
Or this one, trimmed with ribbons.
...Oh, sir! It suits you wonderfully.
I'm not the one who'll be wearing it...
Speaking of beauty, Miss Rose of the
Epstein family also honors this shop
with her patronage.
She's a truly lovely lady, you know.
Some new hats came in yesterday...
I'm sure they'd suit you perfectly...
